title: Book Three · Chapter 184: Fifteen Working Weeks
story:
At the end of December, Ronan asks Mr Sun about work after the new year.

His local school term is complete. He can give more time now, but he wants a clear finishing date before summer.

Mr Sun opens the work book. The counter helper is still there. She handles the morning collection papers. The workshop also needs written replies and afternoon customer work.

“Fifteen weeks,” he says. “From the first Monday in January.”

He shows Ronan the final Friday on the calendar. It is in spring, before Ronan's birthday.

“Monday to Friday. Nine until four, with twelve until one for lunch.”

Ronan copies the hours. Six working hours a day. Thirty each week. He copies the last Friday beneath the first work date.

“Six yuan for each day,” Mr Sun says. “Thirty on Friday after the five days.”

The rate is one yuan an hour, as in Ronan's last summer agreement. This time, there are more hours.

“I can do that,” Ronan says.

Mr Sun writes the dates and the pay. He shows Ronan the front tasks and the written orders.

The trained workers will still do the cutting and making. Ronan will check papers, meet customers, and help with finished pieces.

The counter helper turns a paper cover toward him.

“I kept your question line,” she says. “And added my little pictures.”

Ronan smiles. There is space for both on the cover.

At home, he tells Mum about the fifteen weeks. She reads the hours, then points to the lunch break.

“You can eat here most days.”

“I can walk back.”

Dad comes in while they are talking. He looks at the last date and gives Ronan the paper back.

“A longer piece of work.”

“A real chance to save.”

Dad nods. Mum puts the calendar note beside Ronan's study folder.

That evening, Ronan tells Anna about the agreement. They meet near the library, where she is finishing a new drawing.

“Still time on Saturday?” she asks.

“Yes. And Sunday.”

“I have my group on some Saturdays.”

“Then we can ask each other first.”

She smiles and puts her hand in his.

They walk until the cold wind reaches the open corner. Anna turns her collar up, and Ronan helps free one edge from beneath her bag strap.

At home, he puts his work cloth beside the water bottle. There is no new pay yet. On Monday, the first six hours will begin.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

rate＝按每小时等单位计算的报酬；written order＝书面订单记录；trained＝受过训练的；strap＝包带。

## 理解问题

1. 新约持续多久、每周哪几天、每日实际几小时、怎样付款？
2. 原前台帮手是否被挤走？这章新工资已到账了吗，哪些工作仍由熟练成人完成？

## 读句子

**She handles the morning collection papers.**

拆开看：She / handles / the morning collection papers.

那位前台帮手／负责处理／上午取货的单据。
